question.wording: Is this seller charge NOT a selling expense — not a sales commission, advertising fee, legal fee, loan charge that was the buyer's responsibility, or other cost to sell (for example a payoff, a tax proration or an escrow deposit)?

options.label: No — a cost of selling the property

default.because: An escrow or settlement charge is not counted against the gain unless a preparer says it was a cost of selling (the CPA, 2026-10-04: escrow figures do not reach capital gains by default).

citation.wording: Determine your selling expenses. These are the costs directly associated with selling your home.
